license_note: The NousResearch/Hermes-4-405B repository declares license llama3 in its model metadata and ships no LICENSE file of its own, so the grant is Meta's Llama 3.1 Community License with its incorporated acceptable-use policy: attribution and redistribution duties, a Built with Llama display requirement, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and prohibited-use categories, making the release source-available rather than open source.

license_evidence.scope: Hermes-4-405B weights derived from Llama-3.1-405B, licensed under Meta's Llama 3.1 Community License as declared by the repository metadata
Acceptable-use policy incorporated by reference into the Llama 3.1 Community License

access_boundary: This record represents the Hermes-4-405B flagship of the Hermes 4 family. The 14B and 70B siblings, the Hermes 4.3 line, the Hermes 3 line, the base Llama-3.1-405B weights, the Hermes Agent system, and Portal-hosted agents are separate boundaries.
strengths: Hybrid reasoning with toggleable think chains, tool use, and structured outputs documented in the model card and a dedicated technical report
Versioned 405B open weights with safetensors manifests on the developer's own Hugging Face organization
tradeoffs: The Llama 3.1 grant bars use above the monthly-active-user threshold without Meta's permission and names prohibited uses, so commercial reuse needs legal review
The 405B dense checkpoint needs multi-accelerator serving hardware, and no developer API serves it, so running it is entirely self-operated
